theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_un_normal_local_smooth
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν₀ : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (V : Set (Euclid m)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ V ∧ InjOn ψ V ∧ ψ '' V = W ∩ M ∧ (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → ContinuousOn ν₀ M → (∀ x ∈ M, ν₀ x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν₀ x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν₀ x) v = 0) → ∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g O ∧ ∀ z ∈ M ∩ O, g z = ν₀ z
